notes: Cash-basis school district; all funds governmental (no enterprise funds; business_type null). Top-level receipts/disbursements/transfers from the Total Governmental Funds column (p6, right half of p5 statement). Roll-forward: 6,876,216 + 9,458,676 - 9,354,088 + 145,950 - 145,950 = 6,980,804. Beginning/ending cash is the total fund balance (cash + county treasurer funds + investments); investments 1,253,202 (p4) shown for information only. Balance sheet is the Statement of Net Position - Cash Basis (p1); no liabilities. Local receipts split into tax/other lines using the fund budget schedules (they sum to 3,395,254 and tuition 16,571 matches the Statement of Activities p2); county receipts and Other receipts also split by the fund schedules/columns. State receipts kept as one line (all state aid). Disbursement 'Other' 323,246 split into activities 322,947 (Other Governmental column) and bond fees 299. Detail: budget comparison schedules for every fund (General p7-8, Employee Benefit p9, Depreciation p10, Special Building p11, School Nutrition p12, Bond p13, QCPU p14, Activities p15, Student Fees p16); zero-actual lines (e.g. 3300 Community Services, 6423, 6700, 4525 Perkins, QCPU building improvement, Special Building building acquisition, Nutrition purchased services/capital outlay, student fee receipts) omitted. Transfers in detail are other financing lines; printed receipt/disbursement totals that include them carry includes. Transfer cross-check: General schedule total disbursements 7,716,131 is 178,360 higher than General column spending on the statement net of Employee Benefit and Depreciation spending (7,537,771); this equals the transfers to Employee Benefit 28,360 (p9) and Depreciation 150,000 (p10), so a contra line (-178,360) and a matching other financing line were recorded (program lines unknown), review flagged; the General detail expenditure items therefore sum to 7,537,771, and the printed Total disbursements 7,716,131 (p8) carries includes ['other financing'] because it contains those 178,360 of hidden transfers (8000 transfers 122,975 are below that total, outside_printed_total). General 5200 transfers 43,707 = Student Fees 22,975 + Employee Benefit 20,732; 8000 transfer 122,975 = Nutrition 25,000 + Activities 97,975. Bond fund disbursement total printed twice (once recorded). Read pages 1-16 of 16
